Capabilities

Two disciplines, one eye

What's available to commission right now — reach out if you don't see quite what you need.

Vignette making

Roblox cinematics

  • Full scene construction in Roblox Studio — terrain, structures, and clutter placed to support the shot, not just fill the frame.

  • Custom lighting rigs, fog, and time-of-day tuning to set the mood before a single character is even placed.

  • Posing, camera blocking, and prop placement built to read clearly even at small thumbnail size.

  • A final grade pass — contrast, split-tone, grain — to pull every element into one unified color story.

Graphic design

Brand & promo

  • Roblox-ready thumbnails sized and composed to stand out on a crowded catalog page.

  • Marks built to hold up at icon size and at banner size, in flat color or full render.

  • Group banners, Discord icons, and app-icon style sets, delivered export-ready in whatever sizes you need.

  • Reference boards and hero art used to pitch a visual direction before full production starts.
